prompt: My previous query handed back a list of opaque object identifiers. Take those identifiers and give me the detail behind each one - signature, path, line numbers, source excerpt - so I never have to open the files.
rationale: The live contract keys this tool on the 'id' parameter with object ids from prior results. inspect_symbol accepts a bare name, so the discriminator is that the requester holds identifiers rather than a name.
answer_key_evidence: Use the 'id' parameter with object IDs from search results
